    • toString

      String toString(Class<?> type, Object object)
      Converts the specified java object to a string.

      The object to be converted must be of the converter associated java type.

      The string generated by this method must have all information necessary for it to be converted back to the original object.

      Parameters:
      type - type of the object to be converted to a string
      object - object to be converted to a string
      Returns:
      the specified object as a java string

    • render

      String render(Class<?> type, Object object)

      Converts the specified java object to a string.

      The object to be converted must be of the converter associated java type.

      The string generated by this method is intended to be read by humans and there is no need for it to have enough information to restore the original object.

      Parameters:
      type - type of the object to be converted to a string
      object - object to be converted to a string
      Returns:
      the specified object as a java string

    • ofJson

      default Object ofJson(JsonScanner jsonScanner, Type type, Type elementType) throws ConversionException
      Reads an object of the converter associated type from the specified JsonScanner.
      Parameters:
      jsonScanner - scanner from where the JSON object must be read
      type - type of the enumeration or collection element to be read
      elementType - type of the element of the object if the object is a collection or null if not
      Returns:
      the JSON object read as a java object of the converter associated type
      Throws:
      ConversionException - if the next element of the specified JSONReader cannot be converted to a java object of the converter associated type.

    • toJson

      default <T> void toJson(Deque<Object> stack, JsonWriter writer, Class<T> type, T object) throws ConversionException
      Serializes the specified object on JSON notation.

      The string generated by this method have all information necessary for it to be converted back to the original object.

      Type Parameters:
      T - type of the java object to be serialized
      Parameters:
      stack - tracks objects currently being serialized to prevent infinite recursion
      writer - JsonWriter responsible for serializing the object
      type - type of the java object to be serialized
      object - object to be serialized
      Throws:
      ConversionException - if the specified object cannot be serialized on JSON notation

    • fromJson

      static <T> T fromJson(Class<T> type, Type elementType, String string) throws ConversionException
      Parses the specified JSON formatted string into a java object of the specified type.

      The JSON formatted string will be parsed as described on the specified java type associated Converter.

      Type Parameters:
      T - type of the java object to be created
      Parameters:
      type - type of the java object to be created
      elementType - type of the element of the specified object if it is a collection or null if otherwise
      string - JSON formatted string to be parsed
      Returns:
      a java object of the specified type representing the specified JSON formatted string
      Throws:
      ConversionException - if the specified JSON string cannot be parsed into an object of the specified java type
